inputs.label: Ultima IV: Quest of the Avatar (free on GOG)
inputs.help: Your Ultima IV install folder from GOG, where it is free. qgp copies the whole folder.

steps.why: Android creates Android/data/com.SwivelChairGames.ANKHVR/files on the first launch.
Save files copied from a PC must be writable. The guide gives this command for copied .SAV files.

steps.text: Open ANKH-VR from Library > Unknown Sources.

notes: The GOG install folder name is a guess. File names are case sensitive on the Quest, so the push must keep their case. The chmod fails when there are no .SAV files (a new game creates them writable); qgp should treat that failure as harmless, or the step should be skipped when no .SAV was pushed. The asset is really named ANHK-VR.apk. Releases before 0.2.15 are pre-releases.
